integrity: Symbolic generator recurrence and derivative polynomial identities independently recomputed with SymPy; finite rational samples corroborate but do not establish the global theorem.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional overdamped harmonic dynamics with a Brownian active force reset to zero at Poisson times and an independent additive Gaussian bath. Claims cover positive reset, confinement, and active diffusion strengths and finite nonnegative thermal ratio. No generalization to other reset clocks, noise laws, or cumulant orders beyond six is asserted. General prior moment formulas permit derivation; exact publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Thermal broadening preserves the strict ordering of two non-Gaussianity-optimal reset rates
